input: My Brazilian postal codes (CEP) lose the leading zero when I open the file in Excel (01310100 becomes 1310100). How do I fix it?

checks.description: Restores the zeros with TEXT and an 8-digit format
Recommends formatting the column as text before importing
Explains that a postal code is a code, not a number
